answer: A payout is split so that 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The hollow schedule is applied in echo and sparrow publishes each instalment. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4462 identities would post 2243 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
